GRI 1: heading 7309 covers reservoirs, tanks, vats and similar containers for any material, of iron or steel, capacity over 300 liters, not fitted with mechanical or thermal equipment; the empty steel BESS cabinet of 42,722 liters fits (HQ H329722 on BESS containers)

classification.rationale: The steel BESS cabinet, imported complete but unassembled, is classified as the assembled article under GRI 2(a). HQ H329722 (in force) held empty steel BESS containers designed to hold batteries, without mechanical or thermal equipment, to be containers of heading 7309 rather than freight containers of 8609. This cabinet has a capacity of 42,722 liters and no fitted equipment, so it falls in 7309.00.00, statistical line .90 (other than tanks).
